name: gold_for_the_portal
revision: vNext r2 adopted (2026-11-10, owner approved the rewrites): one narrator for every line (Grandma's quote narrated), no the grandson, the gold-protects plant, the new S14 with no line; continuous beat takes.
caption: why does grandma feed the nether portal 😶
logline: Every night Grandma throws one gold ingot into the Nether portal in the cellar and every morning a gift comes back, so her grandson the grandson is sure Grandpa is alive over there, until he throws in a whole stack to buy Grandpa's way home and a piglin steps out wearing Grandpa's helmet.
question: why tf does grandma throw gold into a nether portal every night?
premise: Grandpa went into the Nether 25 years ago wearing Grandma's gold helmet with the blue stripe ('gold keeps you safe in the Nether') and never came back. Every night since, Grandma throws one gold ingot into the portal in the cellar (9,000 of them), and every morning something comes back out of it: obsidian, string, ender pearls, fire resistance potions. Grandma says he's still trading. Her grandson keeps the gifts in a barrel and knows Grandpa is alive.
twist: The gifts are a piglin's barters (a gold ingot in, a random barter item out). Grandpa died over there long ago; a piglin wears his striped gold helmet ('PIGLINS won't TOUCH you in GOLD': a piglin in it means he isn't). Grandma knows ('Just ONE. One's PLENTY.'). Tonight the grandson throws in a whole stack to buy Grandpa's way home, and what steps out is the piglin, shaking, in Grandpa's helmet.

world.where: The Portal Cottage on its ridge north-east of Hushwell; the cellar (library basement) under it with the Nether portal in its east wall
world.canon: New family, not Milo's: the grandson (a player kid, house narrator voice) and his grandma (a plains librarian villager). His grandpa (a player, `ari` skin) walked into the cellar portal on day ~175 and never came back. One ingot a night since, minus the 300 nightless days of the Long Day (800-1100): about 8,825, 'nine thousand' in the kid's round number. Bible: World.

lines.direction: hit only OBSIDIAN, STRING, PEARLS and FIREPROOF, one each; the rest level and quick

lines.text: Twenty-five YEARS ago, / Grandpa went IN. / He WORE / her gold HELMET / BLUE stripe / and ALL.

lines.text: GOLD keeps / you SAFE, / Grandma SAID. / PIGLINS won't / TOUCH you / in GOLD.
lines.direction: hit only SAID and the last GOLD; the rest level and quick
hit only BACK; the rest level and quick

lines.text: So I KEEP / his GIFTS / in a BARREL. / Grandma SAYS / he's still TRADING. / So he's ALIVE. / Grandpa's the BEST / TRADER ever.
lines.direction: hit only BARREL, TRADING, ALIVE and TRADER; the rest level and quick

warm, certain and a little amused, gentle; hit only PLENTY

lines.text: Then I WAITED. / And SOMETHING / stepped OUT.

ending.loop: cause and effect: a piglin wearing his helmet means Grandpa isn't; the gifts were barters, and line 1's 9,000 ingots bought them.

voice_note: Owner's voice-drift rule and Pip's recipe: every narrator line goes in a single-speaker request on gemini-3.8-flash-lite-tts with Pip's direction verbatim and identical in r1 and r2; no per-line directions are sent for the narrator (lines[].note is for the builder and the take check only). Grandma has her own request (r3). Two narrator requests, not one, to keep the brief's limit of about 6 lines per character per request; if one take must carry all ten, merge r1 and r2 unchanged.
hotbar_note: Slots 1-6 are his own things in a cottage with a Nether portal in the cellar: his saved gold (thrown in L11, so slot 1 empties on the throw), a fire resistance potion from the gifts barrel (selected and drunk in S05, then the slot stays the same), golden carrots, torches, lanterns, shears. Slots 7-9 are the ridiculous ones (owner 2026-11-10): a bucket of milk, a whole cake, 67 eggs (owner: "make it 67 eggs"). The mornings' gifts (S04) go into the inventory, not the hotbar: the hotbar is the same in every shot except the throw.
